map.评分容易满分，该怎么用？: The score easily maxes out—how should I use it?
map.评分主要作为“是否落入不良区间”的快速判断；实际厚度精度还受刀片锋利度、皮张含水: The score mainly serves as a quick check of whether you fall into a bad range; actual thickness accuracy also depends on blade sharpness, hide moisture, and tension, so verify by sampling with a thickness gauge.
map.进给太快为什么不好？: Why is feeding too fast bad?
map.进给过快时单位长度内刀刃切削次数减少，易出现波纹与厚度不均；降低进给或提高转速可: When feed is too fast, the number of cuts per unit length drops, causing ripples and uneven thickness; lowering feed or raising speed increases cut density and improves surface flatness.
